description:
Minominomi is an alien girl tasked with capturing Inho, an ordinary guy to study him. Inho doesn't take that very well and attacks her on the spot, believing it's a dream. Soon a relationship filled with antics ensues!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/lovesalien), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/alien_sick), [MComics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/contents?idx=5476), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/51508506), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3493534), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020004103), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=2ttd), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H034057357), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H034057357), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056151)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://daycomics.com/content/101992), [Japanese](https://www.amazon.co.jp/-/en/dp/B0BNQJZT24/)
